title: Effect of exercise on cognitive function and synaptic plasticity in Alzheimer's disease models: A systematic review and meta-analysis.

adjudication.design_quote: The aim of this review was to summarize and evaluate the effectiveness of exercise on cognitive function and synaptic plasticity in AD animal models.
adjudication.k_quote: All of the studies retrieved were animal studies related to exercise and cognitive function.
adjudication.reason: Preclinical animal-model experiments, not randomised controlled trials in humans; not a pairwise meta-analysis of RCTs.
